title: About this model
modeLabel: The mode and time scale are always on screen, for example "Pilot line, 60x, day 3 14:05".

sections.heading: What you are watching
sections.body: A generic 2 nm-class pilot line that makes an AI accelerator chip on 300 mm wafers. Lots of 25 wafers ride in FOUPs through a 240-step route; 42 tools process them, 2 stockers and 32 under-track shelves buffer them, and overhead hoist vehicles on about 465 m of rail move them. It is a lot-level digital twin: every FOUP, vehicle, lamp and robot motion follows from simulated state, not from canned loops. It is not a twin of any real fab; no real fab's layout, tools, process or data are public.

sections.heading: Synthetic traffic
sections.body: In megafab-slice mode, 15 extra vehicles circulate the spine carrying synthetic FOUPs. They are labelled "synthetic through-traffic, standing in for the rest of a large fab", wear a muted slate band and never enter the bays.

sections.heading: The route is compressed
sections.body: The route has 240 steps, while real flows exceed 300. Every lot follows the same route, and every tool of a family is qualified for every step of that family.

sections.heading: Most numbers are estimates
sections.body: Dimensions, process times, failure and maintenance rates and dispatch rules are design estimates unless labelled otherwise. The line starts 4,500 wafers a month (a lot every 4 hours), a rate chosen so the busiest tool families run at about 85 percent of the time; the sourced public scale is a few thousand starts a month. The simulation is seeded and deterministic: the same seed gives the same fab at the same sim time.

sections.heading: What the lamps mean
sections.body: Green P: processing. Amber S: up and waiting. Blue E: engineering or qualification. Blue D: scheduled maintenance. Red U: failed or under repair. Off N: not scheduled for use.

labels.T: typical value or general practice, not specific to any product
labels.E: design estimate; no public value found

product: A generic 2 nm-class AI accelerator on 300 mm wafers.
